section.title: Jurisdiction and Venue
section.para: Claims arise under the Copyright Act (federal statutory), California contract law (CA statutory), and potentially federal constitutional dimensions of authorship rights. Federal copyright claims invoke federal court jurisdiction; contract claims can be heard in CA Superior Court.

Constitutional scope: Federal statutory (Copyright Act, 17 U.S.C.); California statutory (contract law governing artist agreements); federal constitutional (IP clause, Art. I §8 cl. 8) for constitutional dimensions of authorship.
